name: Invisible Hide and Seek
desc:
Invisible Hide and Seek is a fun mix of hide and seek and with invisibility!

🫣 HIDERS: Turn invisible, become props, and use powers to trick seekers. Don’t get caught!
👀 SEEKERS: Find and tag all the hiders. When you catch one, they join your team. Find everyone before time runs out!
🪙 Collect coins to unlock better powers and weapons!

Tags: Invisible, Hide and Seek, Prop Hunt, FPS, Hider, Seeker, Stealth Game, Morph, Hide & Seek, Multiplayer
